sloka: तथा शयानस्य ततः अस्य धीमतः ।यशस्विनो दाशरथेर् महात्मनः ।अदृष्ट दुह्खस्य सुख उचितस्य सा ।तदा व्यतीयाय चिरेण शर्वरी ॥२-५०-५१॥
transliteration: tathā śayānasya tataḥ asya dhīmataḥ ।yaśasvino dāśarather mahātmanaḥ ।adṛṣṭa duhkhasya sukha ucitasya sā ।tadā vyatīyāya cireṇa śarvarī ॥2-50-51॥

translations.english: So, as that illustrious, high-minded and great-souled son of Dasaratha lay there, he who had never known sorrow and was accustomed to ease, the night passed very slowly.
